(2.1) Advise patients to stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before assessing TSH and/or T4 leve1s. (2.2) Starting dose depends on a variety of factors, including age, body weight, cardiovascular status, and concomitant medications. Peak therapeutic effect may not be attained for 4 to 6 weeks. (2.2) See full prescribing information for dosing in specific patient populations.
